title: Select multiple artifacts from one producer
expected: Discover server and migrate artifacts from Go command packages; there is no unique primary executable.
Explicit selectors choose both compatible Linux artifacts at separate stable context paths.
Infer the producer dependency once; preserve executable metadata and verified digests.

cases.name: missing-selector
cases.change: Remove artifact from the multi-output reference.
cases.expect: Ambiguity error listing server and migrate.

cases.name: unknown-artifact
cases.expect: Fail planning with available artifact names; do not select the first output.

cases.name: wrong-platform-cache
cases.change: Offer a Windows or wrong-architecture producer result for the Linux consumer.
cases.expect: Do not reuse it; resolve a compatible variant or fail capability validation.

cases.name: destination-collision
cases.change: Add a source file or second materialization at the same or overlapping destination.
cases.expect: Reject before consumer execution; never silently overwrite.

cases.name: path-escape
cases.expect: Reject a destination outside the consumer workspace.

limitations: Implementation pending; native commands do not prove materialization, policy, or platform propagation.
